request: 이 리뷰 논문의 핵심 분류 체계와 연구 동향, 근거의 한계를 한국어로 분석해줘.
mode: single-paper in-depth review analysis; paper-type-specific narrative review schema

source.access: supplied local full-text PDF; read only
source.title: 빅데이터 활용을 위한 기계학습 기술동향
source.english_title: Machine Learning Technology Trends for Big Data Processing
source.date_evidence: First page says 2012 and copyright 2012; main-text footer explicitly says volume 27, issue 5, October 2012.
source.version: supplied ETRI-layout published article PDF; explicit revision identifier not present
source.doi: not verified from the supplied article
source.page_mapping: PDF file p. 1 = printed p. 55, continuing through PDF p. 9 = printed p. 63
source.paper_type_observed: Narrative technology-trends review: describes existing systems/services and domain adaptation methods; no new author experiment, formal search protocol or meta-analysis is reported.
source.paper_type_identification_basis: Read abstract/contents and sections I–V before selecting the article-specific organization. Category and date were not inferred from the filename.
source.supplements: No supplied appendices or separate supplements are cited as necessary for the requested scope. Original works referenced in the bibliography were not provided or read.

skill_references_used.access_in_this_case: Previously read by this agent in the same session; retained instructions applied without rereading.
skill_references_used.relevance: Paper type checks, exact source identity, evidence labels, locators, proportional depth and critical evaluation.

skill_references_used.access_in_this_case: Previously read by this agent in the same session; retained instructions applied without rereading.
skill_references_used.relevance: Local PDF extraction, visual verification, page mapping and missing-information labels.

skill_references_used.access_in_this_case: Previously read by this agent in the same session; retained instructions applied without rereading.
skill_references_used.relevance: In-depth method/evidence/critique guidance adapted to a narrative review. Training pipelines and empirical reproduction checklists were not forced onto this paper.

reference_selection.reason: The task analyzes one supplied review article. It does not request an independent multi-paper comparison or literature search. The article's cited works were not read as additional sources.

actual_source_coverage.text_read: Complete local layout text extraction: abstract/contents, sections I–V, terminology/abbreviation boxes and full bibliography on PDF pp. 1–9 / printed pp. 55–63.
visual_checks: Title, authors, year, journal volume/issue/month and printed page mapping
NELL subsystem/integrator/knowledge-base loop and example beliefs table
Ford service-concept figure and BigML four-stage workflow
NYT versus Reuters training with common NYT evaluation: figure labels 85.5% and 64.1%, absence of explicit metric name
LININT expression and visually legible prior/feature-augmentation weight notation omitted by text extraction
actual_source_coverage.not_read: No original cited study, project webpage, dataset webpage, external paper, previous answer artifact or other agent output was used.
actual_source_coverage.scope_limit: Analysis establishes what the review reports, not the validity of the original cited experiments or present-day product status.

output_design.taxonomy: Three article-level axes and five domain-adaptation section families; explicitly identifies mixed levels and potential overlap rather than declaring an exhaustive mutually exclusive taxonomy.
output_design.trends: Historical 2012 directions only: distributed execution, persistent knowledge learning, service access and domain reuse.
output_design.evidence: Clearly separates review synthesis, cited project results, diagram/workflow evidence and analyst criticism. No cited experiment is attributed to the review authors.
output_design.limitations: Distinguishes author-described technical limitations from analyst assessment of review selection, heterogeneous sources, missing common benchmarks, metric ambiguity, uncertainty and historical scope.

tools_used_this_case: exec_command: pdfinfo for available metadata and page count
exec_command: mkdir for the isolated temporary extraction/render/cache directory
exec_command: pdftotext -layout for local full-text extraction
exec_command: sed for complete page-spanning text reading
exec_command: rg for focused checks of dates, performance, limitations and review-method terms
exec_command: pdftoppm for PDF page rendering with temporary XDG_CACHE_HOME
view_image for all nine rendered pages
exec_command: Python JSON parsing and artifact size checks

observed_source_issues.issue: PDF creation/modification metadata date is April 2018, whereas the article explicitly identifies October 2012 publication.
observed_source_issues.handling: Used the article's internal publication date. Did not treat the PDF file generation timestamp as publication year.

observed_source_issues.issue: Text extraction omitted some embedded math for prior/feature-augmentation notation on PDF pp. 7–8.
observed_source_issues.handling: Inspected the rendered pages. Output keeps the taxonomy conceptual and only reproduces the verified LININT expression; did not reconstruct absent equations from memory.

observed_source_issues.issue: Figure 5 has performance percentages but no named metric. Main text says roughly 20% degradation; the shown values are 85.5% and 64.1%.
observed_source_issues.handling: Called them performance values, not accuracy or F1; separately labeled the analyst arithmetic difference of 21.4 percentage points.

observed_source_issues.issue: NELL precision/accuracy values are secondary reported numbers; one passage explicitly calls 87% an estimate.
observed_source_issues.handling: Preserved estimated wording and stated that sample, operational metric definition, timepoint and controlled comparison are not reported in this review. Did not attribute this absence to the uninspected primary study.

observed_source_issues.issue: No formal literature search or common method/system benchmark is reported; bibliography contains heterogeneous academic, project and news/workshop sources.
observed_source_issues.handling: Classified the article as a narrative technology review and scoped its conclusions to historical conceptual mapping and examples.
